title: Self-watering bottle planter
summary: The bottle is cut in two; the top sits upside down in the base and a fabric wick keeps the soil moist for days.
summary_ar: تُقطع القارورة إلى نصفين، ويوضع الجزء العلوي مقلوبًا داخل القاعدة، وفتيل من القماش يبقي التربة رطبة لأيام.
result: a clear plastic bottle cut in half, the top half turned upside down into the base, filled with soil and a small green herb, a cotton wick dipping into water below
steps_outline: Rinse the bottle and peel off the label
Start a cut two thirds down with the craft knife, then finish around with scissors
Push a screwdriver through the cap to make a hole and thread the cotton wick through
Screw the cap on, turn the top upside down into the base and fill it with soil
Plant, then pour water into the base so the wick reaches it
safety: Wear work gloves when starting the cut with a craft knife and cut away from your body
Use only bottles that held drinks, never bottles that held chemicals

title: Wooden-spoon bird feeder
summary: Two wooden spoons pushed through a drink bottle become perches, and seed trickles out onto their bowls.
summary_ar: ملعقتان خشبيتان تخترقان قارورة مشروب لتصبحا مجثمًا للطيور، وتنساب البذور إلى تجويفهما.
result: a clear plastic drink bottle filled with bird seed, two wooden spoons crossing through it as perches, hanging from a twine loop on a tree branch
steps_outline: Wash and fully dry a drink bottle
Cut a small hole with the craft knife and a larger one opposite and slightly lower for each spoon
Push the spoons through so each bowl sits under the larger hole
Tie a twine loop around the neck
Fill with seed, close the cap and hang it in the shade
safety: Wear work gloves and cut away from your body
Use a bottle that held drinks only, and keep the feeder dry so seed does not mold

title: Bottle-cap mosaic
summary: Sorted by color and glued to a board, bottle caps make bold pixel-style wall art or a team crest.
summary_ar: أغطية القوارير المرتبة حسب اللون والملصوقة على لوح تصنع لوحة جدارية بأسلوب البكسل أو شعارًا لفريق.
result: a square board covered edge to edge with colorful plastic bottle caps arranged in a simple heart pattern
steps_outline: Wash and dry the caps, then sort them by color
Draw a grid and your design on the board in pencil
Lay the caps out dry to check the pattern and count
Glue the caps down row by row
Let it cure flat overnight before hanging
safety: Glue in a ventilated room and keep small caps away from toddlers

title: Tub drawer organizer
summary: Clean food tubs trimmed to the same height and set in a shoebox tidy a drawer of chargers, spices or craft supplies.
summary_ar: علب طعام نظيفة مقصوصة بارتفاع واحد داخل علبة أحذية ترتّب درجًا للشواحن أو البهارات أو أدوات الحرف.
result: an open shoebox fitted with several clean plastic tubs of different sizes trimmed to the same height, holding cables, clips and small tools
steps_outline: Wash the tubs and dry them
Mark a line at the drawer's height and trim each tub with scissors
Arrange them in the box, big ones first
Glue the tubs to the base and to each other so they don't slide
Fill and label the sections
safety: Trimmed plastic edges can be rough: run a fingernail file along them

title: Bottle-base zip pouch
summary: Two bottle bases joined with a zipper make a round pouch for coins, earbuds or hair ties.
summary_ar: قاعدتا قارورتين متطابقتين يجمعهما سحّاب لتصنعا محفظة دائرية للنقود أو السماعات أو ربطات الشعر.
result: a small round pouch made from two clear plastic bottle bases joined by a bright zipper around the middle
extra_materials: clothes pegs to hold it while the glue sets
steps_outline: Mark a line 6 cm up from the base of both bottles
Start each cut with the craft knife, then trim neatly with scissors
Glue half of the zipper tape inside the rim of one base, holding it with pegs
Glue the other half into the second base, lining up the ends
Let the glue cure fully before opening the zipper
safety: Wear work gloves when using the craft knife and cut away from your body

title: Braided plastic-bag doormat
title_ar: ممسحة أرجل مضفورة من الأكياس البلاستيكية
summary: Bags cut into strips, braided and coiled make a washable doormat that keeps dozens of bags out of the bin.
summary_ar: أكياس مقطعة إلى شرائط ومضفورة ومجدولة في دائرة تصنع ممسحة قابلة للغسل تُبعد عشرات الأكياس عن القمامة.
result: a round flat doormat coiled from thick braids of colorful plastic bag strips, stitched together
steps_outline: Flatten each bag, cut off the handles and bottom seam
Cut the bag into 5 cm loops and link them into long strips
Braid three strips together, adding new strips as you go
Coil the braid flat into a circle or oval
Stitch each round to the one before with strong thread
safety: Keep bags and strips away from small children
Never iron or heat plastic bags to fuse them: it releases toxic fumes

title: Bottle watering can
summary: A few small holes in the cap turn a large drink bottle into a gentle watering can for seedlings and herbs.
summary_ar: بضعة ثقوب صغيرة في الغطاء تحوّل قارورة مشروب كبيرة إلى مرشّة لطيفة للشتلات والأعشاب.
result: a large clear plastic bottle full of water with its cap pierced by small holes, sprinkling water over potted herbs
extra_materials: a scrap of wood to work on
steps_outline: Rinse the bottle and cap
Put the cap face-down on a scrap of wood
Tap a thin nail through it 5 to 8 times with a hammer
Fill the bottle, screw on the cap and water from low down
safety: Hold the cap on the wood with pliers or tape, not your fingers
Never heat the nail to melt holes in plastic

title: Hanging bottle garden
summary: Bottles with a window cut in the side, strung one above the other, grow herbs or flowers on a sunny wall.
summary_ar: قوارير بنافذة جانبية معلقة بعضها فوق بعض تزرع الأعشاب أو الزهور على حائط مشمس.
result: three clear plastic bottles lying on their sides, each with a rectangular opening full of soil and green herbs, hung one above another on twine against a wall
steps_outline: Rinse the bottles and remove the labels
Draw a rectangle on one side of each bottle and cut it out with the craft knife and scissors
Pierce two holes at each end with a screwdriver and a few small drainage holes underneath
Thread twine through the end holes, knotting under each bottle to space them 20 cm apart
Hang the column, then fill with soil and plant
safety: Wear work gloves when cutting and piercing
Use bottles that held drinks only

title: Clamshell mini greenhouse
title_ar: دفيئة صغيرة من علبة طعام شفافة
summary: A clear hinged food container becomes a mini greenhouse that keeps seeds warm and moist until they sprout.
summary_ar: علبة طعام شفافة بغطاء متصل تصبح دفيئة صغيرة تبقي البذور دافئة ورطبة حتى تنبت.
result: a clear plastic hinged takeaway container with its lid closed, filled with soil and rows of tiny green seedlings, condensation on the lid
steps_outline: Wash the container and dry it
Pierce 4-6 drainage holes in the base with a screwdriver
Fill with 3 cm of moist seed mix and sow the seeds
Close the lid and place it in bright, indirect light
Open the lid once seedlings touch it, and transplant when they have true leaves
safety: Press the screwdriver down onto a board, never towards your hand
